# MyDetector

> > MyDetector is a comprehensive AI content detection and writing enhancement platform offering free tools to identify AI-generated text, humanize content, check grammar, and detect plagiarism across multiple languages.

MyDetector provides a suite of free online tools for content verification and writing improvement, supporting detection of content from ChatGPT, GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude. The platform is available in multiple languages including English, Chinese, German, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, and Japanese, making it accessible to a global audience.

## Key Topics

- AI Detection
- ChatGPT Detector
- AI Humanizer
- Grammar Checker
- Plagiarism Checker
- AI Image Detector

- Online Tool

## Core Detection Tools

- [Free AI Detector - Accurate AI checker for chatGPT & More](https://mydetector.ai): MyDetector's main free AI detection tool with 99% accuracy for ChatGPT, GPT-4, Gemini, Claude
- [AI Humanizer Tool: Humanize AI Text with Natural Flow](https://mydetector.ai/ai-humanizer): MyDetector AI Humanizer transforms AI-generated text into natural human-like content
- [AI Essay Checker: An Instant and Reliable Tool](https://mydetector.ai/ai-essay-checker): AI Essay Checker tool for identifying and correcting writing issues
